fact: Botswana's report to the Committee against Torture, received 4 April 2022, states that the Botswana Police Service maintains a Cell Register and an Occurrence Book Register in which all detainees are recorded with the allegations leading to their arrest and detention; it names no electronic system and does not state the medium of the registers.
title: Initial report submitted by Botswana under article 19 of the Convention pursuant to the simplified reporting procedure, due in 2001
